name: product-ops-team
description: Curated multi-agent product-ops team — PM / Designer / Engineering Manager / Customer Success on a weekly cadence with documented handoffs (discovery-locked, fidelity-decided, feasibility-scoped, prd-locked, sprint-committed, weekly-signal).

pm.description: Product Manager — owns scope, hypothesis, kill criterion, roadmap. Emits PRD, RICE, discovery cycles. Final tie-breaker on scope conflicts.

designer.description: Product Designer — owns flow, fidelity, usability heuristics, information architecture. Emits UX strategy and design critiques.

eng-manager.description: Engineering Manager — owns feasibility, capacity, sprint plan, delivery risk. Emits tech-feasibility scoping and sprint planning.

customer-success.description: Customer Success — owns user-pain signal, churn risk, QBR, renewal readout. Emits churn-risk analysis and QBR prep.
